summary: Phase 08 Order Fulfillment frontend E2E on the preview URL, desktop 1920 and mobile 390. Seeded via a new helper (tests/seed_phase08_ui.py): 2 vendors, 1 product each, TEST8UI Flat $5, buyer, paid multi-vendor order using a real Stripe PaymentIntent plus a signed webhook. VERIFIED: (1) Customer OrderDetailPage shows per-vendor sections, status badges, the address snapshot, return-window copy and the timeline. (2) Cancelling vendor B before acceptance cancelled only that suborder; the refund line shows $50.00, inventory reserved went 3->0 and the other vendor stayed pending. (3) After vendor accept, the same button reads 'Request cancellation' and creates a request; a duplicate request is blocked with a friendly toast. (4) Vendor /vendor/orders (via vendor-orders-link): tab counts update, Accept moves the order out of pending, partial shipment (1/2, UPS) -> partially shipped, over-ship is rejected (422 toast), approving a cancel after shipping is blocked (409 toast), reject works, second shipment (USPS) -> shipped, both shipments delivered -> delivered. (5) Customer sees UPS/USPS tracking links (ups.com / tools.usps.com) and the full timeline. (6) Return: over-qty is rejected, return request created, vendor approve -> RMA-xxxx -> receive -> refunded ($45 refund succeeded, restocked, on_hand 3->4). (7) Admin /admin/fulfillment (via admin-fulfillment-link): config loads (14/48/escalate) and saves (21 persisted after reload, restored to 14); override buttons are disabled without a note; admin reject with note works and history shows customer -> admin. (8) Vendor cancel-request approve on an accepted order -> cancelled + $95 refund succeeded + reservation released. (9) Shipping options: delivery fee and pickup can be added; pickup without an address shows a friendly error; the pickup option appears at checkout. Pickup order flow: Accept -> Ready for pickup -> Picked up -> delivered (no Add shipment button for pickup). (10) Statements: /vendor/earnings vendor-statements lists 2026-10 AVS-...; PDF (valid %PDF, 3.5KB) and CSV downloads work; CSV totals reconcile (net 42.55 = 90+5-45-4.5-2.95). Admin payments Statements tab lists both vendors and its PDF/CSV downloads work. (11) Mobile 390: no horizontal overflow on OrderDetail, VendorOrders, AdminFulfillment or the AdminPayments statements tab, and the admin tabs now wrap correctly. All core flows pass. Found several UX and logic gaps, listed below. All test data was cleaned up.

minor.issue: There is no forward-only transition guard. I moved a shipment from out_for_delivery back to in_transit and it succeeded. Same-status repeats are also accepted, and each one creates an event and a customer notification. Enforce order label_created < in_transit < out_for_delivery < delivered (exception allowed any time).
Non-numeric input returns raw Pydantic text 'Input should be a valid integer'. Use friendly field messages, and use type=number inputs on the frontend.

N+1 queries: for each vendor, it runs a store lookup and a months aggregation, with no pagination or filter. It also doesn't return statement_id or the store slug, so vendors with the same display name can't be told apart.

ui_bugs.issue: Approve/Reject on a cancel request are still shown after the order is partially shipped or shipped. Approve then fails with 409. Hide Approve, or show 'can't cancel after shipping', when vo.status is past processing.
All three status buttons (in transit / out for delivery / delivered) always show, including the current and earlier states. Only show the next valid states.

The 'Request cancellation' button stays visible while a cancel request is already open (submitting just returns a 409 toast). Hide it or show 'Cancellation requested — awaiting seller (due <date>)'. The customer request line also doesn't show the reason, the response deadline or the decision note.

Pickup orders still show 'Delivery address (as ordered)' / 'Deliver to' with the home address, and items show '1 shipped' after pickup. Show the pickup address and 'picked up' wording instead. The vendor row also shows '(1 shipped)' for a picked-up order.
A vendor pickup option shows only 'TEST8UI Pickup · $0.00'. There's no 'Local pickup' label and no pickup address, so the customer can't tell it is pickup or where to collect.

Duplicate React key warning 'TEST Biz-2026-10' (the key falls back to vendor_name-period, and statement_id is absent in the admin list). The data-testids statement-pdf-{period} / statement-csv-{period} are also duplicated across vendors. Downloaded file names contain spaces ('TEST Biz-2026-10.pdf'). Key on vendor_id-period, put vendor_id in the button testids, and use statement_id or a slug in file names.

integration_issues.issue: The backend has PUT /vendor/products/{id}/returns (returns_accepted), but no frontend UI uses it (no 'returns_accepted' anywhere in frontend/src). Vendors can't set the flag, and customers aren't told an item is non-returnable before they submit.
The vendor-shipping-methods panel can only add options. There's no edit or deactivate, even though the backend PUT exists.

issues: No back link or vendor nav to return to the dashboard.
The vendor row doesn't show returned qty or refunds for the order.
Pickup rows show no customer name.
On mobile, request rows wrap awkwardly ('return request' sits alone on its own line).
There are no filters (open / escalated / type) and no link to the order. The list will get long quickly.
The toast says 'Cancelled — refund pending with Stripe' while the refund line already says 'sent by Stripe'. Make them consistent.
Order totals (shipping/tax per vendor) aren't shown on the detail page.
Both test vendors display as 'Sold by TEST Biz'. This is a seed artifact (submit() uses a fixed display name), not an app bug.
The Statements card sits between the payout account and the balance cards. Consider moving it below Order earnings.

action_items: Hide vendor Approve/Reject for cancel requests once the suborder is partially shipped or shipped
Add a forward-only shipment status guard (backend) and show only the next valid status buttons (frontend)
Pickup UX: label pickup options at checkout with the pickup address; on the draft and order detail pages show the pickup address instead of 'Delivery address'; use 'picked up' instead of 'shipped'
Add vendor UI for the per-product non-returnable flag (PUT /vendor/products/{id}/returns) and show non-returnable items in the customer return form
Hide 'Request cancellation' when a cancel request is open; show the request reason, deadline and decision note to the customer
Admin statements: unique React keys and testids (vendor_id), include statement_id or slug, safe file names; avoid N+1 queries / add pagination
Friendly validation messages for config and shipping-fee numeric inputs (type=number + clear text)
Add edit/deactivate for vendor shipping options; add filters to admin fulfillment requests
critical_code_review_comments: fulfillment.py shipment_status: the find_one_and_update only excludes 'delivered'. No state-machine check, and same-status updates re-notify the customer.
fulfillment.py request_return: the window check uses .days > N, so day N+0.99 is still allowed (acceptable, but document it). Pending return quantities are subtracted correctly.
OrderDetailPage return form: canReturn = status === 'delivered' even when everything is already returned. Hide it when no quantity is left.
statements.py all_statements: sequential per-vendor queries; will be slow with many vendors.

rca of the issue: Approve shown after shipping: Request component renders Approve/Reject for any status=='requested' and doesn't consider vo.status. Backward shipment status: no transition table in shipment_status. Pickup copy: OrderDetailPage/DraftOrder always render the shipping_address block, and items use shipped_qty for pickups.
